Shoots from afar, cries up close. Send my skeletons over.

Heals the wounded. I heal the dead. Professional rivalry.

Lovely horse. The thing on top is extra. I'll keep the horse.
The rudest way to knock on my door. There's a bell, a bell!
Shoots while running. I'd run too if I were the horse.
Dogs. They show far too much interest in my bones.
Arrogance on wheels. They all look the same after hitting a wall.
A walking apartment block. The tenants pay the rent.
They eat my corpses. That's theft. At least leave the bones.
Hunting witches, apparently. I'm no witch. Witches are polite.
White dogs. They smell bones, and sadly they're right.
Burns everything. Corpses too. What a waste.
Throws holy water. I'd brew my tea with that water.
Whips himself. Doesn't even leave any for me.
A lantern. The night is mine, shine it somewhere else.
Rings a bell. My bones are trembling, not me.
He shines. It's blinding. And his shield is huge.
Interrogates my towers. Towers don't talk.
A stone saint. Curses won't stick, too slippery.
The head of the hunters. Two crossbows. One wasn't enough.
Carries a bell on his back. That explains the back pain.
A fiery nun. She turned my corpses to ash, unforgivable.
A cathedral statue is walking. Someone should tell the architects.
A church on wheels. I don't like its bell.
He has my teapot. End of discussion.
They brought an elephant. I'll build a castle from its bones, with a trunk for a door.
The Emperor's birds. My crows didn't like them at all.

Burning my corpses! That's wasteful. And rude.
His standard is too shiny. I have no eyes, and it's still blinding.
No sense of rhythm. My skeletons dance better.
Throwing rocks into my garden. That's no way to be a neighbor.
His horn is too loud. I can't drink my tea.
Whips up the crowd. The crowd will be mine soon.
Prays to the sun. Around here the sun sleeps until noon.
His armor is so heavy my skeletons can't be bothered to carry him.
Master of shadows. I'm the master of graves. We should meet.
Shouts while charging. Why do they always shout?
He ordered his own statue. I'll gift the tombstone.
An obelisk of bone. Recycled shards.
Old neighbors. They don't pay rent but they hold the door well.
Spirits work here. Even after hours.

The dead worked overtime again today.

Do not disturb Mortimer. Just don't.
The Cursed Border. A peaceful evening.
Earl Grey, silence and not a single guest. Perfect.

When this bell rings, all the dead will kneel!
My dead have no ears. Their own choice.

Blood Moon Hill. The Moon Altar.
